descriptionChirho: Qal sense denoting the exertion of effort in work or labor, focusing on the activity of toiling rather than the resulting fatigue.
Qal sense denoting the state of becoming tired, exhausted, or worn out, whether from physical exertion or other causes.
Hifil causative sense meaning to cause someone to become weary, tired, or exasperated; to wear someone out.
Piel intensive/causative sense meaning to weary or fatigue someone, to make someone tired through persistent action.
